goal: Genuinely enforce the required Miben kér segítséget? service/topic choice for Form33 submissions originating from page272 without changing shared Form33 settings or affecting other pages.

proven_metform_server_contract.entries_api: MetForm Core Entries Api::post_insert obtains wp_get_referer(), converts it with url_to_postid(), and passes that post_id into Action::submit together with the form data.
proven_metform_server_contract.validation_hook: Action::submit applies mf_after_validation_check after built-in validation and rejects the request when the filter returns is_valid=false.
proven_metform_server_contract.native_required_limit: mf_input_required=yes is proven as native client-side required capability, but independent server rejection of a completely absent required radio was not identified in the audited generic PHP validator.
proven_metform_server_contract.existing_project_pattern: Code Snippets ID5 already uses mf_after_validation_check for Form33 photo-count validation. Its exact current body/priority must be read before adding another validation callback.

preferred_scope_without_client_marker.route_guard: Confirm current REST request is the Form33 insert route /metform/v1/entries/insert/33 using the same proven route convention as ID5.
preferred_scope_without_client_marker.page_guard: Inside the server filter, resolve wp_get_referer() through url_to_postid() and require integer post ID 272. This mirrors MetForm's own Entries API origin resolution and avoids adding a hidden frontend marker.
preferred_scope_without_client_marker.form_guard: Require the exact live-read service radio mf_input_name. No field-name inference from label text.
preferred_scope_without_client_marker.existing_error_preservation: If an earlier validation filter has already returned is_valid=false, return it unchanged so photo-count or other errors are not overwritten.
preferred_scope_without_client_marker.other_pages: Return the incoming validation result unchanged for every referer post ID other than 272.

mandatory_reads_before_code_generation: Current Form33 _elementor_data/widget settings for #af-form-service: widget ID/type, exact mf_input_name, exact mf_input_required, current six option values/order.
Current Code Snippets ID5 exact PHP body, priority/registration style, active state and code_error so the new callback cannot mask or duplicate its behavior.
Current Code Snippets ID36 exact body/state because the semantic v003 successor is a separate package and must not be accidentally mixed with submission behavior.
Current page272 accepted Elementor hash/JSON and exact WPVibe quota/headroom when the connector exists again.

implementation_boundary.error_copy: UNSET_UNTIL_CURRENT_NATIVE/SOURCE VALIDATION COPY IS PROVEN; do not invent user-visible text.

acceptance_without_external_delivery: Static/PHP readback: callback registered once, active, no code_error, strict page272 + Form33 route + exact field guards present.
Readback proves existing ID5 body/state unchanged and page272 Elementor/Form33 saved data unchanged.

If a non-delivering local validation path becomes available, prove missing service choice is rejected before entry storage while a populated service value reaches the existing validation chain; do not send an external message.
If no safe non-delivering validation execution is available, keep runtime behavior status explicitly unproven rather than submitting a real form.
rollback: Disable/restore only the exact newly created or updated page272 validation snippet from its pre-read body. Do not alter Form33, ID5, ID6, Elementor data or shared media.
